ownerQuestions.question: Yeldenne's roster capital is Simoto, the model's site_yeldenne_landing on the Gulf of Minnolomak, about 400 px from the Castle of Yeldenne and the valley of Mp'E it is meant to serve; a one-state realm cannot hold both. The seed keeps the site (snapped 28 px onto the drawn coast). Should the landing move below the castle, or the realm's seat move to the valley?

Lerendor's North (decision K49) is seeded in the drawn snow country (Lerenwaith); Sonargur lies on the island's south coast with Tolvael, the Heodwa Lands, Hrakbrund and Mustnom between. The map tool joins a realm's pieces on one landmass by a corridor, which will cut through those realms. Accept the corridor, or make Lerendor's North a separate realm under the same crown?
The Low-ness Islands and Ferlinon's pine hills (roster extent) have no model feature; the old map's Low-ness state projects onto the drawn island of Tolhon. Not placed: where are they?
The drawing labels Pornyior beside Argon (now Mount Argul); the roster says "the slopes below Mount Ergo". The seat follows the drawing. Which mountain?

The model puts Ossi Luni (former Hengyang, Soyano's) on the same island as Hol's Great Volcano (Ihuy's seat). One owner per island gives it to Ihuy; Soyano's seat Ileslia is on the northernmost Sun isle (land_island_023). Agree?

The drawing writes Gelbus and Luminor (Olen) on Mirolon's eastern lowland, which the import joins to the East Lands, not on an isle; Halia's salt coast is placed on the same lowland's south shore because the peninsula's western tongue is too narrow for two seats. Keep Olen on the mainland, or move it to an isle off Mirolon's south coast?

Hirolon claims the crests of its proposed ring (the Hiloff Rim from Hirolon Head to the Hilorn mouth, and the Grano; hirolon.md 2.2) and Tirlan grows inside it from Tirbur at the Hilorn's head-streams. Accept the ring as Hirolon's fixed land?

Kingson claims the model's whole Kingson Vale plain (plain_kingson_vale, about 200 by 300 px including the gorge), larger than its three roster states. Keep the whole vale, or claim only the valley floor?

Ten wild lands are left unowned (Mount Ergo, Mount Argul, the Reeto caves, the high Melty glaciers, the Kherith Isles, the Abyss, the Lustras Hills, the Herrodon crest, the heart of the Fallen Forest, the high snows of the Magic Mountains); every one is proposed in its dossier, and whether the game accepts ownerless states is still to be verified in the Linux run (ADR 0069). Keep them unowned, or give each to the realm that borders it as the old map did?

Realm sizes follow the roster's stated extent where it gives a state count and the old map's state count otherwise (WEIGHT); in regions where the roster states fewer states than the land holds (the Magical Lands most of all) the realms grow larger than their extent, or the wild lands must grow. Accept, or state extents for the remaining realms?

The roster puts Eldafaen on the southern rift shore and its Archive at the southern end of the rift coast; the old map's seat and the drawn Endelond label lie in the north-east of the Magical Lands by the Fallen Forest. The seat follows the roster (south of the Rift Narrows). Which is right, and is Endelond a separate part?

The Triton realms without sites sit on the islands the drawing labels or, where it does not, on the islands the old map gave them: the Seite Islands on the long isle under their label, the Windy Lands on the south of Raerby's arc, Santon on the outer western arc, Halenor on the storm isle south of Kilos, the Lens on the narrow isle east of Adel, Fineger on the northernmost isle. Agree?

Not placed as wild land: the Lost Lands (the drawn Lost and Filion labels lie where Andos Enda's seat stands), Dragon Mountain's summit (the roster gives Yavieth the mountain), the dune sea (Wahatud's oases), the Plutondo Dunes (Rhachia's seat stands in them), the Cursed Square (a reef on the water) and the Dark Lands' Death Islands (no land in the model). Agree?

importObservations: The West Lands and the Cold Lands do not touch: the drawing's sheets leave sea between Holdon's coast and the Gunwyn Downs (no land at y 940 between x 500 and 1400), while the model joins them by the neck (land_western_mainland). The Coldor Channel is also read as water between the Cold Lands and the Yeti shelf.

The Magical Lands sheet ends near x 3830: a strip of open sea (x 3815 to 3830), a pencil-line strip read as land (x 3831 to 3843, y 1100 to 1700) and sea again split the rift coast (the Mushroom Forest and the Rift Narrows) from the rest of the Magical Lands, which the model keeps as one land_central_mainland.

The central and eastern mainlands touch through Mirolon's eastern lowland (about x 3450 to 3700, y 1880 to 2000), and the Nether's eastern tip touches the Sun Desert's western coast near (3240, 2400); with the Nether Sound read as land, the Ember Lands island, the Nether and the East and South Lands form one landmass. The barriers zilin_marches and ember_isles and the Nether's claim keep the regions apart.
Lettering in the sea is read as land, for example the drawn "Ocean of Edvoid" between x 3260 and 3640 at y 660 to 700 north of the Magical Lands.

The workspace's common/country_tags holds only the 19 October world's 305 old Y tags (00_zin_countries.txt) and the dynamic tags; the roster's 156 tags are written by the mod's build to common/country_tags/01_zin_realms.txt (tools/content/modules/countries.mjs), which is not in the tree now. Until the build has written it, the tool refuses every realm (MAP_WORLD_REALM_TAG_UNKNOWN).
